description: An entirely original fictional English-speaking voice for Nell, a twelve-year-old apprentice carpenter in a forest fairy tale. Bright and youthful, clear and agile, lightly textured rather than squeaky. Natural lightly rural English vowels, precise consonants, a quick questioning lilt, and an unforced conversational rhythm. Her intelligence and curiosity are audible; avoid baby talk and exaggerated cartoon acting. Keep this a stable baseline vocal identity, capable of quiet, surprise, tenderness and argument. No imitation of any real person.
quote_evidence: Operator-chosen USD 0.25 local allocation per original voice; NOT a fixed provider quote or billing cap.
